caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical lantern made of brownish metal with a conical top. The lantern is shown with its front door open, revealing a yellow-orange candle placed on a base inside. The metal surface of the lantern is covered with patterned perforations, including starburst or floral designs on the door and walls, and small teardrop-shaped holes near the top. There is a round glass window set into the upper part of the lantern’s body, and a looped metal handle is attached at the peak of the conical roof for hanging. The object is set against a plain, light beige background. There is a small signature in the lower right corner, reading "Dorothea Farrington."
title: Yard Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
